config.input_preprocessing: drop all-zero columns; center by training-card mean; divide by one global RMS norm of training cards
config.costs: excluded (H pays from pool.*, S by exhausting/recycling runes: non-comparable; printed costs are in the stats input)
config.situation_target: mean over executed actions of the situation (all locations, first/last target policy), hide actions excluded; kinds play+trigger only (S has no 'act' rows, 'inplay'/'held' record no delta)

eval1_S_train_to_S_test.metric: group-mean error: mean over target fields of (pred - S-test (card,kind) mean)^2 in z units, averaged over a card's kinds, then over cards; 95% bootstrap CI over cards (seed-averaged)
eval1_S_train_to_S_test.note: per-sample MSE = group-mean error + within-group (situational) variance, which no card-only model can reduce

eval3_S_train_to_H.metric: as eval1 but targets are pool-H (card,kind) means; same cards and kinds as S-train only

eval3b_H_to_S_test.note: H has 1-10 probe situations per card; trained on H (card,kind) means

metrics.err_variant_S: group-mean error of the held-out card vs its mean S delta (S-train+S-test, never trained on)
metrics.err_copy_base_pred_S: error if the model's prediction for the BASE card were used for the variant
metrics.err_base_on_S_test: the same model's error on its base card (trained card) vs the base's S-test mean
metrics.log_ratio_var_vs_copybase_S: log(err_variant/err_copy_base_pred); <0 = the card vector moved the prediction toward the variant's truth
metrics.diff_cos_S: cosine(pred(variant)-pred(base), true mean(variant)-mean(base)) over target fields, S (unpaired situations)
metrics.diff_cos_H / diff_rel_err_H: same on pool H, where variant and base are run in identical probe situations (paired)

eval2_posthoc_measurable_pairs.rule:
Post-hoc (added after seeing results): restrict the difference metrics of eval2 to pairs whose
true difference is measurable.

Rule (data only, no model output used): a pair counts for the S difference metrics if its true
S difference is at least 4x its sampling noise (diff_snr_S >= 4); for the H metrics if its paired H
difference is nonzero (diff_rel_err_H defined). Costs and timing variants have no measurable delta
difference because costs are excluded from the targets and timing does not change the delta.
Bootstrap over pairs (seed-averaged), seed 0, 2000 resamples. Merged into results.json.
